# `try_reflect`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
try_reflect(class, method[, arg1[, arg2 ..]])
```

This is a special version of `reflect` that performs the same operation, but returns a NULL value instead of raising an error if the invoke method thrown exception.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | > 1 |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT try_reflect('java.util.UUID', 'randomUUID');
```

Result:

```text
c33fb387-8500-4bfa-81d2-6e0e3e930df2
```

```sql
SELECT try_reflect('java.util.UUID', 'fromString', 'a5cf6c42-0c85-418f-af6c-3e4e5b1328f2');
```

Result:

```text
a5cf6c42-0c85-418f-af6c-3e4e5b1328f2
```

```sql
SELECT try_reflect('java.net.URLDecoder', 'decode', '%');
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```
